## Send it

Copy this into `bot.ts` and run it. From WhatsApp Android, send `!products` to the bot.

```ts bot.ts
import { Client, html, htmlJson } from 'zaileys'

const client = new Client({ commandPrefix: '!' })

const data = {
  "shop": "Example Goods Co.",
  "currency": "IDR",
  "locale": "id-ID",
  "products": [
    {
      "name": "Cloud Mug",
      "price": 89000,
      "badge": "New",
      "emoji": "☕",
      "description": "Sample product. A chunky stoneware mug that keeps your coffee warm a little longer.",
      "variants": [
        {
          "name": "Mint",
          "hex": "#2ed8a7"
        },
        {
          "name": "Peach",
          "hex": "#ffb27d"
        },
        {
          "name": "Sky",
          "hex": "#38b6ff"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "Canvas Tote",
      "price": 120000,
      "oldPrice": 150000,
      "badge": "-20%",
      "image": "data:image/svg+xml;base64,",
      "description": "Sample product. A roomy tote with an inside pocket, big enough for a laptop.",
      "variants": [
        {
          "name": "Natural",
          "hex": "#f3e3c3"
        },
        {
          "name": "Pink stripe",
          "hex": "#ff4f8b"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "Sunny Sneakers",
      "price": 459000,
      "badge": "Best seller",
      "emoji": "👟",
      "description": "Sample product. Light, cushioned everyday sneakers.",
      "variants": [
        "39",
        "40",
        "41",
        "42",
        "43"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "Pocket Plant",
      "price": 65000,
      "emoji": "🪴",
      "description": "Sample product. A tiny desk plant in a hand-painted pot.",
      "variants": [
        "Small",
        "Large"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "Retro Cap",
      "price": 99000,
      "badge": "Last 3",
      "emoji": "🧢",
      "description": "Sample product. An adjustable cotton cap with a curved brim.",
      "variants": [
        {
          "name": "Yellow",
          "hex": "#ffc93c"
        },
        {
          "name": "Violet",
          "hex": "#7c5cff"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

const card = html`
<!doctype html>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
  :root { --ink: #1d1442; --muted: #5a5170; --cream: #fff8ec; --mint: #2ed8a7; --sky: #38b6ff; --pink: #ff4f8b; --orange: #ff8a3d; --yellow: #ffc93c; --lime: #9be15d; --violet: #7c5cff; --grape: #b44cff; }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  [hidden] { display: none !important; }
  body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #123b5c, var(--ink)); color: var(--ink); font: 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; padding: 10px; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
  .card { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--cream); border-radius: 22px; overflow: hidden; }
  .top { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; }
  .shop { min-width: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .shop span { margin-right: 6px; }
  .counter { flex: none; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .viewport { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; touch-action: pan-y; }
  .track { height: 100%; display: flex; transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.25, .5, 1); }
  .track.dragging { transition: none; }
  .slide { flex: none; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 0 12px; }
  .art { flex: 1; min-height: 110px; position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 20px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--a), var(--b)); overflow: hidden; }
  .art::before { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 70%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .28); }
  .art::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 30%; right: 30%; bottom: 14%; height: 10%; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(29, 20, 66, .18); }
  .art .emoji { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-size: clamp(64px, 20vw, 88px); line-height: 1; transform: rotate(-8deg); margin-bottom: 8%; }
  .art img { position: absolute; z-index: 1; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; padding: 10px; }
  .badge { position: absolute; z-index: 2; left: 10px; top: 10px; max-width: 60%; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--yellow); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; transform: rotate(-6deg); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .3); }
  .info { flex: none; padding: 10px 2px 0; }
  .row1 { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
  h2 { margin: 0; min-width: 0; font-size: clamp(17px, 5vw, 20px); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.15; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .price { flex: none; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .price b { display: block; font-size: clamp(17px, 5vw, 20px); font-weight: 800; color: #c2185b; }
  .price s { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
  .desc { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.35; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }
  .chips { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 8px; overflow: hidden; flex-wrap: nowrap; }
  .chip { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 12px 0 8px; border: 2px solid #eadfcb; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: 700 13px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .12s ease; }
  .chip.nodot { padding-left: 12px; }
  .chip i { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--dot); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(29, 20, 66, .25); }
  .chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); }
  .chip:active { transform: scale(.93); }
  .order { flex: none; margin: 10px 12px 0; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 14px; background: #e3f7ff; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.3; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
  .order span:last-child { min-width: 0; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }
  .order b { font-weight: 800; }
  @media (max-width: 400px) { .order { min-height: 50px; } }
  .more { flex: none; align-self: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
  .nav { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 12px 12px; }
  .arrow { flex: none; width: 46px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--mint); color: var(--ink); font: 800 20px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #1b9f79; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .1s ease, box-shadow .1s ease; }
  .arrow.next { background: var(--pink); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #c42a62; }
  .arrow:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #1b9f79; }
  .arrow.next:active { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #c42a62; }
  .arrow:disabled { background: #eadfcb; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #d3c4a8; color: #8a7f6c; cursor: default; transform: none; }
  .dots { display: flex; gap: 7px; align-items: center; }
  .dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #dccdb2; transition: width .3s ease, background .3s ease; }
  .dot.on { width: 26px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--sky), var(--violet)); }
  .empty { height: 100%; display: grid; place-items: center; text-align: center; padding: 20px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; }
  .empty b { display: block; font-size: 40px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .track, .dot, .chip, .arrow { transition: none; }
  }
</style>
<main class="card" aria-label="Product showcase">
  <div class="top">
    <div class="shop"><span aria-hidden="true">🛍️</span><span id="shop"></span></div>
    <div class="counter" id="counter" aria-live="polite"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="viewport" id="viewport"><div class="track" id="track"></div></div>
  <div class="order" id="order"><span aria-hidden="true">💬</span><span id="orderText"></span></div>
  <div class="nav" id="nav">
    <button class="arrow prev" id="prev" type="button" aria-label="Previous product">←</button>
    <div class="dots" id="dots" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <button class="arrow next" id="next" type="button" aria-label="Next product">→</button>
  </div>
</main>
<script>
  var DATA = ${htmlJson(data)};
  var TEXT = {
    shop: 'Our picks',
    product: 'Product',
    noPrice: 'Ask for price',
    empty: 'No products to show yet.',
    of: function (i, n) { return i + ' of ' + n; },
    orderPrefix: 'To order, reply with ',
    orderSuffix: '',
    variants: 'Options'
  };
  var MAX_PRODUCTS = 5;
  var ART = [['#2ed8a7', '#38b6ff'], ['#ffc93c', '#ff8a3d'], ['#ff4f8b', '#b44cff'], ['#9be15d', '#2ed8a7'], ['#38b6ff', '#7c5cff']];
  var d = DATA || {};

  function str(v) { return v === undefined || v === null ? '' : String(v).trim(); }
  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function num(v) { return typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) ? v : null; }

  function moneyFormat(currency, locale) {
    var loc = locale || undefined;
    try { new Intl.NumberFormat(loc); } catch (e) { loc = undefined; }
    try {
      var f = new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { style: 'currency', currency: currency });
      return function (v) { return f.format(v); };
    } catch (e) {
      var plain = new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
      return function (v) { return (currency ? currency + ' ' : '') + plain.format(v); };
    }
  }
  var money = moneyFormat(str(d.currency) || 'USD', str(d.locale));

  var products = (Array.isArray(d.products) ? d.products : []).filter(function (p) { return p && typeof p === 'object'; }).slice(0, MAX_PRODUCTS);
  var chosen = products.map(function () { return -1; });
  var index = 0;

  $('shop').textContent = str(d.shop) || TEXT.shop;

  function variantOf(v) {
    if (v && typeof v === 'object') return { name: str(v.name), hex: str(v.hex) };
    return { name: str(v), hex: '' };
  }

  // Only #rgb or #rrggbb reaches the style, so data cannot inject other CSS.
  function safeHex(h) {
    if (h.charAt(0) !== '#' || (h.length !== 4 && h.length !== 7)) return '';
    for (var i = 1; i < h.length; i++) if ('0123456789abcdefABCDEF'.indexOf(h.charAt(i)) === -1) return '';
    return h;
  }

  function buildSlide(p, i) {
    var slide = document.createElement('section');
    slide.className = 'slide';
    slide.setAttribute('aria-roledescription', 'slide');
    slide.innerHTML = '<div class="art"></div><div class="info"><div class="row1"><h2></h2><div class="price"></div></div><p class="desc"></p><div class="chips"></div></div>';
    var art = slide.firstChild, colors = ART[i % ART.length];
    art.style.setProperty('--a', colors[0]);
    art.style.setProperty('--b', colors[1]);
    var image = str(p.image);
    if (image.indexOf('data:image/') === 0) {
      var img = document.createElement('img');
      img.alt = str(p.name);
      img.src = image;
      img.draggable = false;
      art.appendChild(img);
    } else {
      var em = document.createElement('span');
      em.className = 'emoji';
      em.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      em.textContent = str(p.emoji) || '🎁';
      art.appendChild(em);
    }
    if (str(p.badge)) {
      var badge = document.createElement('span');
      badge.className = 'badge';
      badge.textContent = str(p.badge);
      art.appendChild(badge);
    }
    slide.querySelector('h2').textContent = str(p.name) || TEXT.product;
    var price = slide.querySelector('.price');
    var b = document.createElement('b');
    b.textContent = num(p.price) === null ? TEXT.noPrice : money(p.price);
    price.appendChild(b);
    if (num(p.oldPrice) !== null && num(p.price) !== null && p.oldPrice > p.price) {
      var old = document.createElement('s');
      old.textContent = money(p.oldPrice);
      price.appendChild(old);
    }
    var desc = slide.querySelector('.desc');
    if (str(p.description)) desc.textContent = str(p.description); else desc.hidden = true;
    var chips = slide.querySelector('.chips');
    var variants = (Array.isArray(p.variants) ? p.variants : []).map(variantOf).filter(function (v) { return v.name; });
    if (!variants.length) chips.hidden = true;
    chips.setAttribute('aria-label', TEXT.variants);
    variants.forEach(function (v, k) {
      var chip = document.createElement('button');
      chip.type = 'button';
      chip.className = 'chip';
      chip.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      var hex = safeHex(v.hex);
      if (hex) {
        var dot = document.createElement('i');
        dot.style.setProperty('--dot', hex);
        chip.appendChild(dot);
      } else {
        chip.className = 'chip nodot';
      }
      chip.appendChild(document.createTextNode(v.name));
      chip.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (moved) return;
        chosen[i] = chosen[i] === k ? -1 : k;
        var all = chips.querySelectorAll('.chip');
        for (var c = 0; c < all.length; c++) all[c].setAttribute('aria-pressed', c === chosen[i] ? 'true' : 'false');
        updateOrder();
      });
      chips.appendChild(chip);
    });
    slide.variants = variants;
    return slide;
  }

  function updateOrder() {
    var p = products[index], slide = track.children[index];
    var el = $('orderText');
    el.textContent = TEXT.orderPrefix;
    var b = document.createElement('b');
    var pick = chosen[index] >= 0 ? slide.variants[chosen[index]].name : '';
    b.textContent = (str(p.name) || TEXT.product) + (pick ? ' (' + pick + ')' : '');
    el.appendChild(b);
    if (TEXT.orderSuffix) el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(TEXT.orderSuffix));
  }

  var track = $('track'), viewport = $('viewport'), dots = $('dots');

  function go(to) {
    index = Math.max(0, Math.min(products.length - 1, to));
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (-index * 100) + '%)';
    $('counter').textContent = TEXT.of(index + 1, products.length);
    $('prev').disabled = index === 0;
    $('next').disabled = index === products.length - 1;
    for (var i = 0; i < dots.children.length; i++) dots.children[i].className = i === index ? 'dot on' : 'dot';
    for (var s = 0; s < track.children.length; s++) track.children[s].setAttribute('aria-hidden', s === index ? 'false' : 'true');
    updateOrder();
  }

  // Chips can't scroll here, so options past the card edge are hidden behind a "+N" count.
  function fitSlides() {
    for (var s = 0; s < track.children.length; s++) {
      var chips = track.children[s].querySelector('.chips'), buttons = chips.querySelectorAll('.chip');
      var more = chips.querySelector('.more');
      if (more) chips.removeChild(more);
      for (var c = 0; c < buttons.length; c++) buttons[c].hidden = false;
      if (chips.scrollWidth <= chips.clientWidth + 1) continue;
      more = document.createElement('span');
      more.className = 'more';
      chips.appendChild(more);
      for (c = buttons.length - 1; c > 0; c--) {
        buttons[c].hidden = true;
        more.textContent = '+' + (buttons.length - c);
        if (chips.scrollWidth <= chips.clientWidth + 1) break;
      }
    }
  }

  var startX = 0, startY = 0, dragX = 0, dragging = false, moved = false;
  viewport.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
    if (products.length < 2) return;
    dragging = true;
    moved = false;
    startX = e.clientX;
    startY = e.clientY;
    dragX = 0;
  });
  viewport.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
    if (!dragging) return;
    dragX = e.clientX - startX;
    if (!moved && Math.abs(dragX) > 8 && Math.abs(dragX) > Math.abs(e.clientY - startY)) {
      moved = true;
      track.className = 'track dragging';
      try { viewport.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}
    }
    if (!moved) return;
    var edge = (index === 0 && dragX > 0) || (index === products.length - 1 && dragX < 0);
    var shift = edge ? dragX / 3 : dragX;
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(calc(' + (-index * 100) + '% + ' + shift + 'px))';
  });
  function endDrag() {
    if (!dragging) return;
    dragging = false;
    track.className = 'track';
    if (!moved) return;
    var w = viewport.clientWidth;
    if (dragX < -Math.min(60, w * .18)) go(index + 1);
    else if (dragX > Math.min(60, w * .18)) go(index - 1);
    else go(index);
    setTimeout(function () { moved = false; }, 0);
  }
  viewport.addEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
  viewport.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);
  $('prev').addEventListener('click', function () { go(index - 1); });
  $('next').addEventListener('click', function () { go(index + 1); });
  addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') go(index - 1);
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') go(index + 1);
  });

  if (!products.length) {
    viewport.innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><div><b aria-hidden="true">🛒</b><span></span></div></div>';
    viewport.querySelector('span').textContent = TEXT.empty;
    $('order').hidden = true;
    $('nav').hidden = true;
    $('counter').hidden = true;
  } else {
    products.forEach(function (p, i) {
      track.appendChild(buildSlide(p, i));
      var dot = document.createElement('span');
      dot.className = 'dot';
      dots.appendChild(dot);
    });
    if (products.length < 2) { $('nav').hidden = true; $('counter').hidden = true; }
    fitSlides();
    go(0);
    addEventListener('resize', fitSlides);
  }
</script>
`

client.command('products', async (ctx) => {
  await ctx.send().htmlApp(card, {
    title: "Product Showcase",
    height: 470,
    device: ctx.senderDevice,
    fallback: "This product showcase opens on WhatsApp Android only. Ask the shop for its product list and prices.",
  })
})
```

| --- | --- |
| Height | 470 px |
| Size | 17.2 KB |
| Input | Swipe, Tap |

The card works only on WhatsApp Android, with no network or storage. Other devices get the `fallback` text. See [HTML apps](/messaging/html-app) for every option and limit.
